text:
Maya Singh: FYI on the auklet-int8 onboarding canary: structured output failures cropping up only when stream=true and client_batch=1. Parser sees valid JSON but wrapped in triple-backticks or preceded by explanation text.
Owen Brooks: Can you paste an example raw chunk?
Maya Singh: ```
Here's the plan:
```
```json
[{\"tool\":\"search\",\"args\":{\"q\":\"redwood inference streaming\"}}]
```
Priya Shah: So model emits a tiny human-like preface then the JSON. Our strict parser rejects it. Failure rate ~0.38% over 8k requests; non-stream mirrored run passes.
Maya Singh: Token trace shows tokens for backticks and words: [TOK_98]=\"```\", [TOK_99]=\"Here\", [TOK_100]=\"'s\" etc, then the JSON tokens.
Owen Brooks: Two tracks: 1) Gatekeeper pre-processor that strips common prose/code fences when they appear immediately before JSON. 2) Add onboarding fuzz that injects friendly prefixes to catch this earlier.
Priya Shah: We should not silently strip in prod. Make sanitizer opt-in per-route and add coercion telemetry (sanitizer_reason: code_fence|prose_prefix|markdown_block). Also a gate to fail canary if sanitizer hits >0.2%.
Maya Singh: Proposed config: structured_output.sanitizers = [\"strip_triple_backticks\",\"strip_leading_sentence\"] default off; telemetry.sanitizer_enabled_tag = true.
Owen Brooks: I'll prototype a lightweight pre-parse that looks for a code fence or short sentence (<= 50 chars followed by JSON start) and trims it. Log original payload to ephemeral debug buffer.
Priya Shah: I'll add the fuzz harness change: vary prefix probability 0..0.05 and chunk boundaries 1..5 tokens, run across batch sizes 1..4. Add dashboard: sanitizer_hit_rate and post_sanitize_parse_success.
runtime-bot: [automated] canary 2888887777 recorded: 8000 requests, raw_parse_fail=0.0038, sanitizer_hit_rate=0.0021, post_sanitize_parse_fail=0.0004.
Maya Singh: Thanks. If post_sanitize_parse_fail < 0.0005 and golden-diff < 0.1% we can allow canary in staging with sanitizer opt-in.
Owen Brooks: I'll land a small PR for gatekeeper sanitizer; Priya please add the fuzz job and dashboard.
Priya Shah: On it.
Maya Singh: Cheers :coffee:
